Right in the middle of Rookgaard's wilderness, beneath the bear cave, there is a {item:Dead Dragon|dead dragon} surrounded by fire fields. Cross the fire, open the dragon's body and take a {item:Bag} with a {item:Copper Shield} and a {item:Legion Helmet}.
No minimum level; level 5 recommended (from level 7 you can do it without potions).
102 oz of free capacity (Copper Shield + Legion Helmet + Bag).
to open the hole by the lake
Extra food to recover health (light on capacity: {item:Egg|Eggs}, {item:Cookie|Cookies}, {item:Cherry|Cherries}, {item:Blueberry|Blueberries}).
Don't waste the potions in the bear cave: save them for the fire fields.
Make sure you have 102 oz free before you go in, or you won't be able to carry the loot.

Buy a {item:Shovel}, a {item:Scythe} and 2–4 {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions}. Leave the village of **Rookgaard** and head **east**, through the countryside, to the bear cave (at the indicated spot). The entrance is a hole: go down it.
Go down the hole. There are many {creature:Bear|Bears}: run past them or kill them, but don't get cornered. The cave splits into two paths: take the **south** one.
If you want to kill the bears, stay in the narrow passage: that way only two attack you at a time. Don't use the potions yet.
At the end of the path there is a lake and a hole. Open it with the {item:Shovel} and go down.
Recover health and cut the wheat
Eat and wait until your health is full. Then use the {item:Scythe} on the {item:Wheat|wheat} to clear a path.
Wheat to cut with the Scythe
You have to cross 4 large fire fields and 1 medium one (and come back). Run non-stop to the {item:Dead Dragon}. Drink a potion when your health goes into the red.
The fire drains health with every step. Don't stop in the middle of the fields.
Open the {item:Dead Dragon}: inside is a {item:Bag} with a {item:Copper Shield} and a {item:Legion Helmet}. Take them.
The bag found inside the dragon
Bag with Copper Shield and Legion Helmet
**Don't wait** for your health to recover: head straight back to the entrance, crossing the fire again. That way you save potions; if you are quick, 2 potions and some food are enough.
From level 7 you can do the quest without potions: reach the dragon, pick up the loot, wait until your health is full and leave.

After the fire, go back to where you came down (the hole by the lake), climb up again to the bear cave and follow the **south** path in reverse to the entrance, **east** of Rookgaard (watch out for the {creature:Bear|Bears} again). From there return to the village, to the **west**. Bring a {item:Rope} just in case you need it to climb up.
